name: Workshop-use report
about: After using the tool with applicants, report what it caught and what it missed.
title: "[workshop] "
labels: workshop-report
---

Thank you for sharing a workshop-use observation. This is the
single most useful kind of feedback for calibrating the package.

**Reminder: please do not include identifying applicant content.**
Desensitise everything before submitting — describe the
structural pattern, not the specific research.

## Setting

- Workshop type (e.g., national ERC workshop, university preparatory
  workshop, mock interview, lead-reader session).
- Stage of the applicant's draft (Pitch, Part I + CV, Full proposal).
- Mode used (Basic / Standard / Advanced / Mock interview / Resubmission).
- Provider/model used (if known).

## What the AI caught that you would also have caught

The routine structural items: vague hypothesis, ambition without
contingency, CV-as-pub-list, weak cross-panel, missing risk
section, PI-project fit gap. Count is fine; specifics in
desensitised form are better.

## What you caught that the AI missed

This is the load-bearing observation. What did your human reading
surface that the AI's output did not? Field-specific objections?
Panel chemistry concerns? Novelty judgments? Recent-literature
positioning?

## What the AI flagged that you considered a false positive

Where did the AI fire a cap or raise a finding that you, as
human reviewer, would not have raised?

## How long the AI critique took the applicant

If known. If the applicant did not run the tool (only the reader
did, with consent), say so.

## Anything else worth knowing

Free text. Any pattern that does not fit the categories above and
that you think the maintainer should know.
